claims: Brock Lesnar has retired from professional wrestling.
Brock Lesnar lost to Oba Femi.
Brock Lesnar's match to Oba Femi opened the second night of WrestleMania 42.
The second night of WrestleMania 42 took place at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.
Brock Lesnar removed his gloves and boots in the center of the ring.
Brock Lesnar left his gloves and boots in the ring.
Brock Lesnar embraced longtime manager Paul Heyman to conclude his final match.
Fans acknowledged Brock Lesnar with "Thank you Brock" chants.
